opportunity: The first round of `libctypes` was designed from the platform headers. This one was designed from the corpus's ground truth: of the 11,687 pointer-to-named-struct variables the 444 corpus twins hold, which could a libc declaration have named, and which declaration? The answer is dominated by one name the shipped table could never reach -- `obstack`, 431 GT variables, 371 of them inside a function that calls `_obstack_newchunk` or `_obstack_begin` DIRECTLY, and imported in 0 of the 444 slices because gnulib links its copy in and the linker exports the symbols from the program (15 slices elsewhere in the same results tree -- the five dpkg programs at each optimization level -- do import glibc's, which is why the size slots follow the channel rather than the corpus).
test_name: tests/stages/kuna-libctypes.xml #27-#32 (two new fixtures: libctypes_obstack_x86_64, where _obstack_newchunk is DEFINED by the image and putspent imported, and libctypes_obstack_import_x86_64, where _obstack_newchunk is imported from glibc and must take that header's `int` size slot) + 6 unit tests in analyzers::protos::kuna_libctypes::tests (the_defined_table_is_obstack_entry_points_only, the_two_obstack_tables_differ_only_in_the_size_slots, each_obstack_channel_keeps_its_own_size_spelling, the_account_database_slots_name_both_aggregates, and the duplicate/width tests) + tests/cli/sharded-project-export-keeps-serial-structs.json
flag: KUNA_LIBCTYPES (load-time env bridge) -- no new option
inspiration: Ghidra ApplyDataArchiveAnalyzer applying generic_clib_64.gdt; signatures reduced from `gcc -aux-info` over the platform headers (_GNU_SOURCE + _FORTIFY_SOURCE=2); widths from sizeof/_Alignof, cross-checked against the corpus's own DWARF

mining.method: decbench's own DIE walk (final/gtclass.py) over the unstripped twin of all 444 slices, recording the pointee struct tag of every `ptr_struct` GT variable; `readelf --dyn-syms` for what a STRIPPED image carries (imported vs defined-and-exported); `objdump -d` per function for what each variable's own function calls; `gcc -aux-info` (3,428 declarations) for which aggregate each libc function traffics in

refused._ftsent: 100 GT vars; gnulib's fts is linked in like obstack, but `fts_open` is an ordinary name a program may define itself
refused.sgrp: 61 GT vars; same, for shadow's own gshadow
refused.argp_state: 6 GT vars; same, for gnulib's argp
refused._obstack_allocated_p: no installed declaration to reduce, exactly as `__underflow` in round one

table.defined_name_rule: the only table matched against `unambiguous_present_function_names` rather than the imported names: the `_obstack_*` entry points are the implementation-reserved half of obstack.h, written only by glibc or by the gnulib copy of the same file, and both publish the same `struct obstack`. Every other table stays imports-only.
table.obstack_size_slot_rule: pointer-width, not the `int` the installed glibc header spells at obstack.h:184. Two published declarations of one symbol exist (glibc's, and the gnulib copy every obstack in this corpus is compiled from, whose _OBSTACK_SIZE_T is size_t); the corpus's own debug info says which applies. Both pass in a register, so only the rendering moves -- `int` would put a truncating cast on every call.
table.off_is_unchanged: every new name is new to BOTH shipped tables, asserted per row, so `libctypes off` is byte-identical to what it was

benchmark.instrument: scripts.decbench.typesweep through docs/decbench/typecampaign/final-c/finalsweep.py, decbench PINNED to 625e892, DECBENCH_NO_CACHE=1; the two arms are two builds of this tree over the same slices. Run twice: first at base 2e28ece4a, then in full again after the rebase onto 724381149 (argclobber #689) with the base arm built from origin/main's kuna_libctypes.rs + protos/mod.rs in this tree. Identical both times, per-variable tables included.
benchmark.corpus: results/full_run_address_2026-09-11, O0+O2+O2-noinline, 9 projects, 444 slices, 10,748 scored functions
benchmark.control: the baseline arm reproduces the campaign's published round-D numbers exactly: 1,349 perfect, mean 0.3403

worse_functions.coreutils::O0::pinky print_long_entry: 0.4286 -> 0.2143; three variables move from a stack slot to a register and decbench never exports a register local, so they stop being scored rather than being mistyped

arity.why: every new name is new to both shipped tables, so each supplies an ARITY where there was none -- the user's rule asks for arity/phantom counters beside type_match
arity.verdict: nothing is fabricated; the change is a retyping

speed.method: interleaved min-of-15, `decompile-all --max-fn-seconds 120` over five whole binaries, the two builds alternating on every repetition (.scratch/speed.py, copied to docs/features/libcstructs/speed.py)
speed.note: measured under campaign load (8 other lanes plus this lane's own workspace suite); interleaving is what controls for it

confirmation_run.why: the two largest deltas re-measured once this lane's own workspace suite had finished

known_regressions.method: branch built twice, the second build with only the named table row removed
known_regressions.gzip::O2::lutimens: the timespec * slot on utimensat/futimens re-splits a 144-byte stat frame slot into char v5 [80] plus three detached words the body reads and nothing writes; over the 30 corpus slices that import utimensat/futimens, 122 functions gain a timespec rendering, 3 lose a stat declaration, 1 of those is under-declared; main already prints 7 of the same shape, this branch 8
known_regressions.openssh::O2::ssh_signal: the sigfillset(sigset_t *) slot splits a 152-byte sigaction frame slot at 136, so the sa_flags store escapes the object handed to sigaction(): sigaction v4 -> char v4 [136] + a dead undefined4 v7 at stack - 0xd0. 444-slice corpus: 6 slices import sigfillset (coreutils env, shadow su), 0 sigaction declarations lost, only added sigset_t renderings. Disjoint openssh -O2 sweep: 7 binaries, 1 function each (ssh/ssh-keygen/ssh-agent/ssh-add 11 -> 10, sshd 3 -> 2, scp 2 -> 1, sftp 2 -> 1). Class pre-exists via the shipped sigemptyset slot: on the ablated build the same program with sigemptyset prints the identical split, and ssh-keygen's base arm already prints 18 (sigaction *) cast-at-use sites against this branch's 19
known_regressions.statfs_name_collision: statfs is both a new aggregate name and a libc function name: O0 shadow usermod sub_111a1 prints `statfs v1;` and calls `statfs(a0,&v1)`, so that body does not compile as printed; the .h emitter already guards its half. Same collision main has for stat
known_regressions.verdict: disclosed, kept; all three are instances of classes the option already ships, see analysis.md
